stem.text: The potential difference $V$ across a filament lamp is slowly raised from zero to its normal operating value.
Which graph represents the variation with $V$ of the current $I$ in the lamp?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled V, both starting from 0. A curve starts at the origin and rises with decreasing steepness.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled V, both starting from 0. A straight line starts at the origin and rises.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled V. A curve starts at the top of the vertical axis, falls and levels off to the right.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled V, both starting from 0. A curve starts at the origin and rises with increasing steepness.
